# DEWALT DCS355D2-GB 18V 2 x 2.0Ah Li-Ion XR Brushless Cordless Multi-Tool(10048)

(447)

Ask a Question

DEWALT 18V XR brushless, cordless oscillating multi-tool, designed for cutting, sanding, and scraping in wood, metal, and plastic. Features a variable speed trigger for precise control up to 20,000 oscillations per minute. A quick-change clamp allows for tool-free blade and attachment swaps, and an integrated LED work light improves visibility in dark or confined spaces. Compatible with all Dewalt 18V XR batteries. Supplied in a TSTAK kit box with 2 x 2.0Ah Li-Ion batteries, a fast charger, and a 19-piece accessory kit to support a wide range of applications.

*   2 x 2.0Ah Li-Ion Batteries
*   60min Charge Time
*   Single-Speed Variable
*   Tool-Free Blade Change
*   All-Metal Gearing
*   Trigger Switch
*   LED Work Light
*   Rubber Overmould Grip
*   Brushless Motor
*   3.2° Oscillating Angle for Cutting
